description: Work Permit CANCELLED on 15 Oct 2026: MOM levy stops 1 day before cancellation, so 1-14 Oct is levied: MOM daily rate S$19.73 x 14 days = S$276.22.
source: MOM 'Cancel a Work Permit' (retrieved 2026-09-29, sha256 2bc8e148..., last updated 5 Aug 2026): "Your worker's levy will be charged until 1 day before the pass cancellation" / "When levy stops: 1 day before cancellation".
